conf.description: Palo Alto NGFW Traffic log (json over HTTP, PAN-OS 10.2/11.1), direct route: JSON extract of the 7 attribute keys shown in the work order's example HTTP Payload Format template, action-driven event.outcome; remaining traffic fields left unmapped because their JSON key names are operator-defined and not shown beyond the template's example

conf.comment: Palo Alto NGFW Traffic log, json over HTTP, direct route. The work order gives one illustrative payload template (src,dst,spt,dpt,action,rule,app,...) rather than a full field table - this pipeline is pinned to exactly those 7 keys. Per the brief's rule against guessing operator-chosen field names, the remaining traffic catalog (nat pairs, proto, srcuser/dstuser, byte/packet counters, device_name, sessionid, any timestamp) is NOT mapped here since the template's '...' does not show their actual key spelling. _raw is kept (not dropped) because this partial mapping does not capture the full record.

functions.description: Pipeline purpose, template-pinning caveat, and the unmapped-field gap
Extract the HTTP payload's JSON object into top-level fields
Derive event.outcome from the vendor action value BEFORE rename
Rename the 7 keys shown in the work order's example payload template to their ECS targets
Tag event.dataset; _raw intentionally kept since this pipeline only maps a subset of the operator-defined payload
